# SocialReins

> Open-source social media manager for Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, Bluesky, X, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest. Self-host it free today; the cloud is not open yet.

- [Home](https://socialreins.com/): what SocialReins does and the waitlist
- [Contact](https://socialreins.com/contact): send the team a message
- [Privacy Policy](https://socialreins.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://socialreins.com/terms)
- [Data Deletion](https://socialreins.com/data-deletion)
- [What you can post where](https://socialreins.com/post-types): post types each network supports
- [Supported social media](https://socialreins.com/socials): every network, each linking to its own page
- [Features](https://socialreins.com/features): everything it does today, in seven groups: publish, plan and schedule, engage, automate, team, measure, build on it
- [Automations](https://socialreins.com/features/automations): keyword triggers and flows with waits and buttons, and which networks support them
- [Inboxes](https://socialreins.com/features/inboxes): comments, mentions and DMs in one place, DMs as conversations, and which networks support them
- [What you can post to Bluesky](https://socialreins.com/bluesky): post types and limits on Bluesky
- [What you can post to Threads](https://socialreins.com/threads): post types and limits on Threads
- [What you can post to LinkedIn](https://socialreins.com/linkedin): post types and limits on LinkedIn
- [What you can post to Facebook](https://socialreins.com/facebook): post types and limits on Facebook
- [What you can post to Instagram](https://socialreins.com/instagram): post types and limits on Instagram
- [What you can post to YouTube](https://socialreins.com/youtube): post types and limits on YouTube
- [What you can post to X](https://socialreins.com/x): post types and limits on X
- [What you can post to TikTok](https://socialreins.com/tiktok): post types and limits on TikTok
- [What you can post to Pinterest](https://socialreins.com/pinterest): post types and limits on Pinterest
- [Pricing](https://socialreins.com/pricing): self-hosting is free; the cloud version is not open yet and has no price set
- [Docs](https://socialreins.com/docs): guides for the self-hosted and cloud versions
- [Install SocialReins on your own server](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted): Docker Compose install, domains, platform apps, updates
- [Connect accounts and publish, self-hosted](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted/use): accounts, posts, the queue, CSV upload, recurring posts, feeds, approvals, the library, inbox, automations, broadcasts, newsletters, analytics
- [Connect an AI assistant to your own SocialReins](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted/ai): MCP server and API tokens
- [Create the network apps for your own SocialReins](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted/apps): developer app, redirect address and keys for each network
- [Get started with SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud): not open yet, waitlist
- [Connect accounts and publish on SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud/use): the same guide for the cloud version
- [Connect an AI assistant to SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud/ai): MCP server and API tokens
- [Network apps on SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud/apps): we register the apps for you
- [Guides](https://socialreins.com/guides): practical guides to scheduling, approvals, self-hosting, inboxes and posting cadence
- [How to schedule a post to several social networks at once](https://socialreins.com/guides/schedule-post-to-several-networks): per-network captions and the limits to plan for
- [Running a social media approval workflow with a small team](https://socialreins.com/guides/social-media-approval-workflow): roles, the approval switch and what a reviewer sees
- [Self-hosting a social media scheduler: what it takes](https://socialreins.com/guides/self-hosting-a-social-media-scheduler): Docker, Postgres, media storage, network apps, backups
- [Social inbox and automations: what a small team can automate](https://socialreins.com/guides/social-inbox-automations): triggers, actions and per-network limits
- [Open source versus hosted social media tools: how to choose](https://socialreins.com/guides/open-source-vs-hosted-social-media-tools): control, cost, maintenance and network apps
- [A realistic posting cadence for a 1 to 5 person team](https://socialreins.com/guides/posting-cadence-small-team): a starting rhythm, with opinion labelled
- [Compare SocialReins](https://socialreins.com/compare): SocialReins next to other tools
- [SocialReins vs PostSyncer](https://socialreins.com/compare/postsyncer)
- [SocialReins vs Manychat](https://socialreins.com/compare/manychat)
- [SocialReins vs Buffer](https://socialreins.com/compare/buffer)

- [SocialReins vs Postiz](https://socialreins.com/compare/postiz)
- [SocialReins vs Publer](https://socialreins.com/compare/publer)
- [SocialReins vs SocialBee](https://socialreins.com/compare/socialbee)
- [SocialReins vs Metricool](https://socialreins.com/compare/metricool)
- [SocialReins vs Sprout Social](https://socialreins.com/compare/sprout-social)
- [SocialReins vs Post Bridge](https://socialreins.com/compare/post-bridge)
- [SocialReins vs Mixpost](https://socialreins.com/compare/mixpost)
- [SocialReins vs Ayrshare](https://socialreins.com/compare/ayrshare)
- [SocialReins vs SocialPilot](https://socialreins.com/compare/socialpilot)
- [SocialReins vs Agorapulse](https://socialreins.com/compare/agorapulse)
